create_lunary_logger: create a LunaryLogger instance to log LLM events to lunary.ai
log_event_lunary_logger: log an LLM request event with input, output, usage, and error data to lunary.ai
parse_usage: parse a usage dict with completion_tokens and prompt_tokens into a completion/prompt summary
parse_tool_calls: parse tool call objects into a serializable list of type, id, and function details
parse_messages: parse message input (string, dict, or list) into a clean serialized role/content format
